problemStatement.formal:
Let\[V'(x)=\#\{\phi(m) : 1\leq m\leq x\}\]and\[V(x)=\#\{\phi(m) \leq x : 1\leq m\}.\]Does $\lim V(x)/V'(x)$ exist? Is it $>1$?



It is trivial that $V'(x) \leq V(x)$. In \cite{Er98} Erd\H{o}s suggests the limit may be infinite. See also [416].
